subagent_run: 2026-06-09 (entrance-gate ornate-arch / portcullis — rule FUN_1c94 in/out for the residual ~11%)
summary: RULED FUN_1c94 IN as the routine that draws the entrance-gate look-back PORTCULLIS LEAF GRID (gx127 gy121 f2), via a live compose-page write-watch. BUT the deeper conclusion overturns the task premise: the leaf grid ALREADY RENDERS CORRECTLY in our port. FUN_1c94 IS the per-span wall blitter we already ported (compositor.ts renderPieceCall) — it is called once per drawn span (the 4 tile-2 corridor/door spans of case-04, walltype!=0xff). Rendering case-04's captured spans through our compositor reproduces the gold/red portcullis lattice, and the diff vs the engine confirms the gate INTERIOR (leaf grid) MATCHES — the residual mismatch is the FRAME-EDGE silhouette (recess-depth jamb shading) + dither, concentrated in two thin vertical bands at the left/right of the gate opening. The arch FRAME is drawn by FUN_0a93 (the OR ARCHWAY_FRAME, byte-identical to the engine's 34-OR / 0-masked captured call-list, self-compose ceiling 79.93% OR-only / 89.21% with the wall pipeline). Adding the door-recess pieces the engine does NOT OR-blit (24/27/30/33) makes it WORSE (78.09%), confirming the engine's OR set is exact. The residual ~11% is therefore the SAME dither + recess-depth residue that caps EVERY maze view (the documented self-reproduction ceiling for static-placement compose) — NOT a missing FUN_1c94 wall-span path. No wireable improvement was found beyond what already renders; the view is AT its 89.21% floor. Findings + capture tooling delivered (probe-gate-arch.ts / probe-gate-arch-src.ts); the render path, wall-spans data, and freeroam gate test are unchanged (already correct).
